headline: Bing retires legacy SOAP/POX APIs Aug 2026; Cloudflare expands MoQ infrastructure

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Bing to retire legacy SOAP/POX APIs on August 31, 2026 | Bing将于2026年8月31日停用旧版SOAP/POX API
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 依赖Bing Webmaster Tools API进行批量数据抓取、排名监控或报告自动化的团队必须迁移到新API，否则服务中断。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Bing Webmaster Tools官方账号宣布，SOAP/POX格式的旧版API将于2026年8月31日正式停用。这是官方API渠道的直接通知，非推测。迁移窗口约14个月，涉及任何仍在使用legacy API进行程序化访问的工作流。
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: audit现有Bing API集成，评估迁移至REST API的时间表

sources.name: BingWMC
sources.excerpt: ANNOUNCEMENT!! Using the Bing Webmaster Tools SOAP/POX APIs? These legacy APIs will be retired on August 31, 2026. Pleas
sources.author: BingWMC

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Cloudflare expands Media over QUIC with isolated relays and pub/sub access | Cloudflare扩展MoQ基础设施，新增隔离中继与发布订阅功能
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 虽非直接搜索产品，但Cloudflare基础设施层的变化影响AI爬虫抓取效率、实时内容分发及边缘SEO策略，尤其涉及agentic traffic和AI搜索引用的内容可达性。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Cloudflare官方宣布在其全球网络中扩展Media over QUIC (MoQ)能力，新增isolated relays和pub/sub access。这是2024年MoQ上线后的功能扩展。对SEO的间接影响在于：更快的媒体传输可能改善Core Web Vitals，而pub/sub架构可能改变内容被AI爬虫发现和抓取的方式。
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: monitor Cloudflare PACT rollout timeline for AI crawler traffic routing

sources.name: Cloudflare
sources.excerpt: Last year, we brought Media over QUIC (MoQ) to our global network. Today, we’re adding isolated relays & pub/sub access
sources.author: Cloudflare

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Glenn Gabe: AIO blame deflection masks core update damage | Glenn Gabe指出：将流量下滑归咎于AI Overviews可能掩盖真正的核心更新问题
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 提醒SEO专家在诊断流量下跌时区分AI Overviews影响与核心算法更新，避免错误归因导致策略失误。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Glenn Gabe（data_research级别来源，trust_weight 0.85）观察到一种行业现象：部分公司在经历核心更新或垃圾更新导致排名下滑后，将原因归咎于AI Overviews。这是基于其客户案例的观察，非系统性研究。缺乏具体样本量或对比数据，但来源权威性较高。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: diagnose traffic drops using Search Console segment by query type, not AIO assumption
